title: 409 — accepting an agreement that is already ACCEPTED
description: The FX lifecycle only allows PROPOSED -> ACCEPTED. Replaying step 9 of the happy path is refused, which is also why this API needs no idempotency key: replay safety is per-endpoint and payload-keyed, and there is no Idempotency-Key, If-Match or ETag anywhere.
notes: BLOCKING DIVERGENCE, verified in the delivered gateway (grpcErrorToHTTP in internal/http/handlers): gRPC FailedPrecondition maps to HTTP 409 Conflict. Both the platform OpenAPI document and contracts/pvp declare 412 Precondition Failed on accept, reject, cancel and settle. A client written against the contract handles a status it will never receive. The body is the raw gRPC error string; the exact wording is implementation detail, so assert on 409 only.

body.error: rpc error: code = FailedPrecondition desc = FX agreement "aaeca49d-89f2-4bf1-9410-0779f50b9754" is in state ACCEPTED, expected PROPOSED
